prediction.text:
Costco's membership fee revenue rose 10% in fiscal 2025. Management said the U.S. and Canada fee increase, effective September 1, 2024, accounted for approximately 40% of membership income growth. Because fees are recognized ratably, the increase had an immaterial impact in the first quarter, when revenue grew 8%.
Costco reported that membership fee revenue increased 10% in 2025, driven by new member sign-ups and membership fee increases.
Costco increased its annual membership fees in the U.S. and Canada effective September 1, 2024. Management stated the fee income increase accounted for approximately 40% of membership income growth during 2025.
Costco accounts for membership fee revenue on a deferred basis, recognized ratably over the one-year membership period. Due to this deferral, the fee increases had an immaterial impact in the first quarter of 2025, when membership fee revenue rose 8%, driven by new member sign-ups and upgrades to Executive Membership.

caveats: The filing gives no dollar amount for the fee-driven portion of growth, only the approximately 40% share of membership income growth.
Only Item 7 of the FY2025 10-K and the Q1 FY2025 10-Q were searched; Item 7A and the other quarterly filings were not.
